comment: Golden vectors for firmware-telemetry/v2 Controller Profiles. A consumer must accept every document in 'cases', reproducing its canonical bytes and digest; refuse every document in 'reject_cases', each of which breaks exactly the one rule its 'rule' names; refuse every byte string in 'reject_bytes'; reproduce every interpretation in 'interpretations' and every verdict in 'ranges' and 'agreements'; and reproduce every state case in 'states', stated at the longest bound. No profile here describes a real product.

reasons.invalid_profile_document: the document breaks the grammar of firmware-telemetry/v2 The profile document
reasons.non_canonical_document: the document's bytes are not exactly the canonical bytes of the object they parse to

states.name: promotion_of_rotated_key_after_pending
states.note: the rotated key takes effect at its promotion, which leaves no latest reading

states.name: reboot_counts_as_later
states.note: seq runs on across a reboot within one key epoch; the later boot's first reading is the latest
